review:
Space Donkey is a 6x6 sci-fi slot. Abduction Wilds land on reels 2 to 6, stay on the grid after joining a win and move down while getting stronger for the next drop. Three or more chopper symbols trigger Hellfire.

The game spells out its cap: once a round's total passes 14,649x, it ends and pays that amount. Nolimit rates it High volatility.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
